items.label: diagnosis
items.evidence: the name of the index (provided in the command line) is not being used to create the directory (an automatic name is generated).
items.rationale: Correctly says the specified name is ignored in favor of an autogenerated one, which is the mechanism the fix changes. It names no specific function or line.

fairness.reason: The test checks that a name set in settings is respected when index_name is "default", for both build_index and search_query. The issue describes this behavior: the specified name is ignored and an autogenerated one is used. The test mocks get_directory_index and index_search, but the expected behavior follows directly from the issue.
